accepted_invariants: The C callback pump installs its guard only after ada_lua_dispatch returns; actual K callbacks are invoked by the C pump with saved status/context and do not nonlocally jump across active Ada scheduler frames.

Each pending C call now records its owning activation. Suspension selects the foreign boundary belonging to that activation rather than repeatedly marking the nearest sentinel; three nested K boundaries are covered by named case20 and the unchanged coroutine tail.
Resume preserves its live scalar execution window and places host-facing results outside suspended registers; a later resume roots supplied arguments before restoring the saved execution view.

Completed child resume driver/call/context/native-depth ownership is restored before fallible host-result publication, so a refused result-window growth cannot strand the parent under the completed driver.

A successfully completed thread with an actual new callable can be reused through public C resume; missing-body/error-dead/running states remain distinguished. Independent from-state identity supplies depth without replacing the resumed universe.

Synchronous success returns to the original C body even when yieldable. A protected error in a yieldable K-aware frame reaches K even before a yield; resumed error versus YIELD status and full-width context are real frame data.

C hook line/count yields preserve the interrupted instruction and live registers. Public valid getstack/getinfo line inspection skips the synthetic transport callback; suspended debug locals use the retained hook PC.
The public C debug selector scope is explicitly l only. Expired-frame rejection is an Ada safety invariant and is not claimed as valid native C behavior.
Retiring C activations run their actual to-be-closed slots on return/error/resumed continuation, with retained outgoing result/error roots through collection.
